documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and operational efficiency, with consolidated total income growing by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores and EBITDA increasing by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores. The company expanded its owned fleet during H2 FY26 by inducting the offshore support vessel Artemis and announced plans for further vessel additions and long-term contracts. Looking ahead, management expects a conservative 10% increase in turnover for FY27, backed by favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market and government maritime initiatives. ABS Marine Services Limited reported a consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26. Management highlighted the induction of the OSV 'HADES' and an MPSV vessel to strengthen the company's offshore capabilities and asset base.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover for the current financial year from current levels, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: Management projects an estimated tax rate of around a maximum of 1.5% to 2% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about opportunities in the offshore and maritime sectors, supported by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and increased shipbuilding support packages.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the opportunities emerging within the offshore and maritime sectors. India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives such as the Maritime India Vision 2030, which outlines over 150 strategic initiatives with projected investments of INR3 lakh crores to INR3.5 lakh crores, along with the recently announced INR69,725 crores support package for shipbuilding.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, driven by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry supply constraints favor charter rate growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry supply constraints (aged global fleet, limited new builds) favor charter rate growth

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated a total spend of about $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and the MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion.
capex_expansion.quote: Received Delivery of Offshore Vessel – AM PASSION

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year. EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income stood at INR183.11 crores, EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year. EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have just come out of charter, and a third newly acquired vessel is headed for dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a total of 12 vessels, including four smaller vessels on a 7 plus 2 year charter running in Chennai and Ennore ports.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat. Four of them, two of them running in Chennai Port and two of them are running in Ennore Port. So, totally we have a, you know, 12 vessels. Those vessels are on 7 plus 2 year charter.

orders_capacity.claim: The top 10 clients contribute around 90 percent of revenue.
Strategic contracts secured amount to over ₹350 Cr.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects a turnover increase of 10% from current levels in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management guides for an estimated tax rate of maximum 1.5% to 2% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

management_commitments.claim: Management scheduled delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company stays committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
